new.statement: Drawing-as-input party games (your drawing comes to life as the round's hazard, or is scored against the original) reach Up-and-Coming within three weeks but settle in its lower half with weak like ratios
new.rationale: Profiled 2026-11-15: Survive Your Drawing (8 days, #59, 34% likes) and Draw the Other Half! (19 days, #68, 66% likes) entered Up-and-Coming, while Draw an aquarium is among the weakest on Top Trending and Paint and Hide! among the weakest on Most Popular. Confirm if more drawing games enter but stay below #50 and leave within two weeks; refute if one reaches the top 20 or Most Popular.

qualitative_updates.note: With a fresh Most Popular list, Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (about 17 days), Ragdoll Sandbox and Realistic Ragdoll Engine fell off and Ragdoll Playground (49 days) dropped 29, while 12-day Ragdoll Destruction Playground and 13-day Sandworm Playground entered. Hyper Realistic Ragdoll left all four charts on the same day.

The ragdoll wave is also branching into combat: Realistic Ragdoll MMA (10 days), Anime Ragdoll (20 days), Ragdoll Awakening (10 days) and untitled ragdoll game (22 days, Top Trending #35 and Up-and-Coming #9) all entered as fighting or rampage variants, and BoneBox Engine rose 79 on Up-and-Coming.

Class Clowns (19 days) entered Most Popular and Mukbang Students rose 47 on Up-and-Coming, but the teacher-side Be a Teacher! (63% likes) fell 36 on Top Trending and 47 on Up-and-Coming. The student-prank side carries the theme; the teacher-side version does not.
Two Anomaly job sims were among today's five biggest Most Popular risers: Sell Fries! [Anomaly] +27 at 55 days and Animal Hospital (Anomaly) +21 at 189 days.
Raise The Biggest Family rose 24 on Most Popular at 33 days, after +34 on Up-and-Coming yesterday.
